Hi,
I'm Carlo Perassi (as you might have guessed :smiley: ) and this is my introduction.

I am a computer engineer. My focus lies in distributed architectures and machine learning, which I started working on, unfortunately, a few decades before it became mainstream :smiley: .

On the math side (spare time):

I will do my best to adhere to the community netiquette.

Thanks for your work on Lean and Mathlib.
